key_idea: Simulate the list: if the winner is ranked below the loser, remove the loser and reinsert it directly below the winner.
sketch: Keep the ranking as a vector. For each game find positions px (winner) and py (loser); if px > py erase the loser and insert it at index px, which after the shift is immediately after the winner. O(n*m) with n, m <= 100. Pitfall: off-by-one on the insertion index after the erase shifts everything up.
